EGREGORA.Subtitle: The Occult World

autoSeedCoreSkills.name: Auto-seed the 12 Official Egrégora Skills
autoSeedCoreSkills.hint: Automatically adds the 12 core Egrégora skills when creating new Awakened characters and NPCs.

enableDoomPoints.name: Enable Doom Points (Optional Rule)
enableDoomPoints.hint: When enabled, pushing a roll grants +1 Doom Point to the Narrator.

EGREGORA.Name: Name
EGREGORA.AnchorPlaceholder: Object, person, place, belief, or pact keeping you tethered to reality...
EGREGORA.TensionPlaceholder: e.g. Instinct vs Control, Faith vs Freedom...
EGREGORA.ConceptPlaceholder: I am a ___ seeking ___, yet bound to ___.

Corruption.Label: Corruption
Corruption.ContaminationFailText: Astral taint erupts: lose an action, act aggressively for a scene, or trigger an unstable supernatural manifestation.
Corruption.ContaminationSafeText: You contain the advancing corruption for now.

Magic.NoSpells: No spells recorded in the grimoire.

s1.title: 1 Success — Unstable Manifestation
s1.desc: The spell manifests at its minimum threshold. Short range, fleeting duration, or obvious traces.

s2.title: 2 Successes — Refined Effect
s2.desc: Solid control. Choose: +1 Damage, double Duration, or affect 1 Additional Target.

s3.title: 3 Successes — Significant Potency
s3.desc: The spell imposes itself immediately; may trigger critical effects or stable physical alterations.

s4.title: 4 Successes — Dramatic Feat
s4.desc: Terrifying display; can cover an entire zone and trigger a Fear Test in witnesses.

s5.title: 5+ Successes — Threshold Breach
s5.desc: Rewrites local reality almost permanently or on a massive scale.

Trauma.TraumaSufferedText: Rolled 1: your maximum Mental Power is permanently reduced by 1. At 0 max MP, the character succumbs to madness.
Trauma.TraumaAvoidedText: You endure the breakdown without losing maximum Mental Power.

NPC.RolePlaceholder: Creature type or role (e.g. Cultist, Ghost, Egregora)...

RollDialog.Title: Egrégora Roll
RollDialog.ActorBrokenConfirm: {name} is Broken (0 HP or 0 MP). Roll anyway?

Notifications.SelectTargetToken: Select at least one target token on the canvas.
Notifications.MacroOwnedItemsOnly: Only owned items can be turned into hotbar macros.
Notifications.CorruptionMutationMilestone: Corruption reached {pc} PC! Roll a Corruption Mutation.
Notifications.ShadowBeastReached: 10 PC — SHADOW BEAST! The character has been completely consumed by Corruption.

r6.title: Keep It Together
r6.effect: You hold your nerve, feeling the weight of the Veil. No extra effect.

r7.title: Nervous Tic
r7.effect: Anxiety spreads. All nearby allies immediately lose 1 MP.

r8.title: Astral Tremor
r8.effect: Your hands shake from resonance. −2 dice to Agility and Combat rolls.

r9.title: Drop Relic / Item
r9.effect: Startled, you drop your weapon or Anchor. The Narrator chooses which.

r10.title: Freeze (Stasis)
r10.effect: Paralyzed by horror, you lose your next turn.

r11.title: Seek Cover
r11.effect: You must spend your next action fleeing danger or hiding.

r12.title: Resonance Scream
r12.effect: Lose 1 extra MP, and every ally who hears you must immediately make a Fear Test.

r13.title: Hallucinated Flight
r13.effect: You flee to safety and refuse to leave. Lose 1 MP.

r14.title: Violent Outburst (Berserk)
r14.effect: You must attack the nearest creature or ally until someone is Broken.

r15.title: Catatonic Collapse
r15.effect: You collapse mentally broken. Immediately roll a Permanent Mental Trauma check.

m66.name: Gaze of the Abyss
m66.cost: Sometimes sees things that are not there

n11.name: Predator Instinct
n11.cost: Urge to finish off helpless victims

a31.name: Fanged Maw
a31.cost: Face moves on its own (−3 Empathy)

a66.name: Avatar of the Rift
a66.cost: Test Intelligence or completely lose control

13.name: Sprained Wrist
13.effect: Drop held item. −1 to Ranged and Melee Combat.

14.name: Sprained Ankle
14.effect: Fall prone; −1 to Agility and Stealth.

15.name: Concussion
15.effect: Stunned for one turn. −1 to all skills.

16.name: Bruised Leg
16.effect: Fall prone; −1 to Agility and Stealth.

21.name: Broken Nose
21.effect: Stunned for one turn. −2 to Persuasion.

22.name: Broken Fingers
22.effect: Drop held item. −2 to Ranged and Melee Combat.

23.name: Broken Toes
23.effect: Stunned for one turn. −2 to Agility and Stealth.

24.name: Teeth Knocked Out
24.effect: Stunned for one turn. −2 to Persuasion.

25.name: Groin Strike
25.effect: Stunned 2 turns. 1 damage per Strength, Agility, or Melee roll.

26.name: Dislocated Shoulder
26.effect: Stunned for one turn. −3 to Strength and Melee Combat.

31.name: Broken Ribs
31.effect: Stunned for one turn. −2 to Agility and Melee Combat.

32.name: Broken Arm
32.effect: Stunned for one turn. −3 to Ranged and Melee Combat.

33.name: Broken Leg
33.effect: Fall prone; movement halved and −2 to Agility and Stealth.

34.name: Torn Ear
34.effect: Stunned 1 turn, −2 Observation. Permanent ugly scar.

36.name: Punctured Lung
36.effect: Lethal (D6 days). Stunned 1 turn. −3 to Agility.

41.name: Lacerated Kidney
41.effect: Lethal (D6 days). Stunned 2 turns. 1 damage per Strength, Agility, or Melee roll.

42.name: Crushed Foot
42.effect: Lethal (D6 days). Prone, movement halved, −3 Agility and Stealth.

43.name: Crushed Elbow
43.effect: Lethal (D6 days). Stunned 1 turn, −2 Strength/Melee; cannot use 2H weapons.

44.name: Crushed Knee
44.effect: Lethal (D6 hours). Prone, movement halved, −3 Agility and Stealth.

45.name: Crushed Face
45.effect: Lethal (D6 hours). Unconscious D6 hours. −2 to Persuasion.

46.name: Pierced Intestines
46.effect: Lethal (D6 hours). 1 damage per hour until first aid.

51.name: Broken Spine
51.effect: Lethal (D6 hours). Unconscious D6 hours; paralyzed from the waist down.

52.name: Broken Neck
52.effect: Lethal (D6 hours). Unconscious D6 hours; paralyzed from the neck down.

53.name: Bleeding Gut
53.effect: Lethal (D6 minutes). 1 damage per turn until first aid.

54.name: Internal Bleeding
54.effect: Lethal (−1 Healing, D6 minutes). Unconscious D6 hours; 1 damage per physical roll.

55.name: Severed Artery (Arm)
55.effect: Lethal (−1 Healing, D6 minutes). Unconscious D6 hours. −1 Agility.

56.name: Severed Artery (Leg)
56.effect: Lethal (−1 Healing, D6 minutes). Unconscious 6 hours. −2 Agility.

61.name: Mangled Arm
61.effect: Lethal (−1 Healing, D6 minutes). Arm permanently lost; −2 Agility; no 2H weapons.

65.name: Instant Death
65.effect: The Entity of Death has come to claim you. Create a new character.

v11.name: Ricochet
v11.effect: Attack ricochets off the vehicle and hits another random target in the same zone.

v14.name: Skid
v14.effect: Driver tests Movement immediately; failure loses the next slow action.

v24.name: Driver Hit
v24.effect: The driver takes damage equal to the damage inflicted on the vehicle.

v31.name: Passenger Hit
v31.effect: A random passenger takes the same damage plus a personal critical injury.

v41.name: Severe Spin
v41.effect: Driver tests Movement; failure flips/wrecks the vehicle (aircraft crash for D3 + altitude).

v44.name: Fuel Fire
v44.effect: Everyone inside suffers Intensity 6 Fire every round.

v51.name: Weapon Disabled
v51.effect: One mounted weapon is destroyed (or re-roll if none).

v54.name: Massive Crash
v54.effect: Vehicle is wrecked; occupants suffer D6 + altitude damage.

v61.name: Engine Disabled
v61.effect: Vehicle cannot move (aircraft may attempt controlled landing).

v64.name: Explosion
v64.effect: Vehicle explodes: everyone inside suffers Power 9 Explosion and the vehicle is destroyed.
